benchmark.financing: 6% fixed annual debit ACT/360 on previous closing USD cash for elapsed calendar days; charge at current close before order sizing. Zero credit interest, disable native per-security margin interest; no terminal accrual beyond final close.
benchmark.execution: Per-sleeve signal-change intent preserved. MOO reductions first; after confirmed sales, re-evaluate current causal signals at next close and buy no earlier than subsequent open. At most one reduction batch per unchanged intent. No spending unfilled proceeds. Buy cash cap leaves10% NAV reserve,25bp slippage and fee reservation, sequential native initial-margin preflight, halve only until affordable. No daily target maintenance after intent completion. Pending order guard; every skipped/clipped/deferral counted.
benchmark.fee_model: Original IB margin/default fees retained;2USD +.01USD/share reservation for fees in sizing, actual native fees unchanged
benchmark.claim_boundary: References are official-export aggregate-compatible, not qualified local daily-decision/account reproduction. Original trace absent is disclosed; a qualified transparent restatement may be tested only against freshly audited matched T11 controls, and must be labeled restatement, never original-parity proof.

selection.instruction: Research a different target/strategy-choice mechanism from saved T11 decisions, freeze one selection change while holding gate and sizing fixed; no correlation-greedy sector retry.

risk.instruction: Diagnose path-dependent T11 leverage/concentration, distinguish embedded ETF leverage from cash financing; freeze one risk/sizing or intent-execution change, not a gate+selector combination.
